business_problem: Trade Ledger needed to turn fragmented lender data into auditable, rules-driven credit workflows that support faster decisions and better risk management.
solution_summary: Trade Ledger built its lending-as-a-service platform on MongoDB Atlas running on AWS so banks and non-bank lenders could model messy borrower data as documents instead of forcing every source into rigid relational schemas. Atlas stores the many data types required for credit decisions in one flexible model, making it easier to absorb source changes, preserve auditability, and enforce business rules across a regulated lending environment. Because Atlas is managed, the team can focus on credit workflows instead of database operations, while still isolating customer data and keeping records in specific regions when needed. That foundation helps lenders approve credit faster, reduce costs, and improve conversion without sacrificing governance.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores borrower and lender data as flexible documents for Trade Ledger's lending workflows.

data_flow: Borrower and lender data from many source systems is modeled as documents in MongoDB Atlas, where Trade Ledger's lending workflows can evaluate applications, enforce rules, and surface credit decisions.
business_outcome: Trade Ledger helps lenders convert more borrowers at lower cost and compresses lending cycles from days or months to minutes, hours, and single-day funding.
metrics: Customers are reporting a 50 per cent increase in conversions with a 50-70 per cent reduction in costs.
It can now take as little as four minutes for a borrower to apply for a loan online, compared with 30 hours via traditional credit applications.
Loans can be approved within an hour, and first drawdown time has been reduced to as little as a day, down from typically 90 days previously.
architecture_clues: The platform uses a document data model to combine multiple data sources with different schemas.
Atlas runs as a managed service on AWS.
Fine-grained data management helps keep customer data isolated and region-specific when required.
evidence_quotes: The flexibility of the document model allows Matt's team to bring data from multiple sources with different schemas into a single data source without writing long lines of code or breaking the database.

MongoDB Atlas's fine-grained data management tooling allows Trade Ledger to give its customers and partners full confidence that data is secured, isolated from other data sets and stored in specific regions.
Customers are reporting a 50 per cent increase in conversions with a 50-70 per cent reduction in costs.
